name: @kitstak/pm-bridge
description: Shared-database bridge into KitStak Projects (the pm schema) for CRM and WMS: read linked projects/tasks for a record, create tasks and links, and emit events that Projects automations react to. Works over any Drizzle Postgres executor (node-postgres, postgres-js, PGlite). Fails soft when the pm schema is absent. TypeScript source-shipped (consumers transpile via Next transpilePackages).
